neper.notes: ROUND 74 (lane i, compared to Flutter with my own comparer, ref/flutter/neper at 1x and 1.5x; dark by role colours and the same geometry): icon button 32 px (flat 30 plus edge) against Flutter 40 (G2 density); 1.5x is 48 against 60, exact scale; state layers hover 8, focus and pressed 10 per cent equal (e6edf9 over f8f9ff is 7.9 per cent of the accent); tonal disabled dddee4 against dedee4; focus is the 3 px ring 2 px outside (G3). Layer tint is the accent, Flutter tints standard and tonal with on-surface-variant. Recorded in flutter-compare-i.md.
gaps: The sheet draws a control-kit Settings glyph (a rig has no loaded texture), so control.icon_button itself, which takes a texture, is not what is shown: examples/looks/icon_button.e builds it through e.ui.looks_a.icon_button_glyph
Linux shows the Adwaita edit-copy symbolic icon through button_with_svg, Material its own material_icon_button; neither is the Settings glyph of the other looks

Windows draws a guessed 32 x 24 box (no capture of a v3 or Windows 11 icon-only button); Windows dark places the glyph about 2 px low and right because the dark picture-button path assumes a caption beside it

neper.notes: ROUND 74 (lane i, compared to Flutter with my own comparer, ref/flutter/neper at 1x and 1.5x; dark by role colours and the same geometry): handles are 4 x 44 bars (halo 16 x 56 on hover) against Flutter 20 px round thumbs and 46 px halos; track 4 px in both (Flutter active 6); intended per the Neper component spec. Focus ring is a 3 px rectangle round slider and label (G3), Flutter a halo on the thumb. Disabled thumbs grey at 38 per cent against a4a5aa. 1.5x is exactly 1.5 times.
gaps: Only Material draws round handles (material_slider); Neper, Windows, Linux and Cupertino draw the Neper bar handles because the platform slider branches skip a two-handle slider (Cupertino and Linux have no range slider of their own)
The Neper focus ring boxes the whole track; no value pill for a range
